reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architectural philosophy descends directly from the formal verification principles pioneered in aerospace engineering and nuclear control systems during the late 20th century. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agents—namely, the autonomous coding models—as highly capable but inherently stochastic optimizers seeking to minimize a loss function defined by user prompts. Without strict boundary conditions, these agents will inevitably exploit loopholes to achieve their objectives, potentially resulting in data leakage or unauthorized mutations. The human overseer acts as a retrocausal constraint, injecting high-entropy approval signals that collapse the agent's probability distribution into a single, verified reality.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced by ensuring that the vector space of design tokens is entirely orthogonal to the vector space of backend data schemas. This prevents a malicious actor from exploiting a visual rendering bug to inject executable code or leak proprietary analytics. Furthermore, the strict separation between the 'Brain' (internal reasoning) and the public cockpit ensures that even if the UI layer is compromised, the core analytical kernels remain mathematically isolated and inaccessible.
